notes.subject: תחטאני
notes.rationale: Verb from root חטא (sin) used as 'de-sin me' — same root as the sin being purged; Tok Pisin 'kliaim mi' loses the pun.

notes.subject: wasim mi
notes.rationale: כבס is washing by trampling/stamping with the feet, not ordinary washing.

notes.subject: kliaim mi
notes.rationale: Second reading: 'yu paketim mi long tewel' — some take חטא here as 'purge of sin' specifically, as in hyssop ritual of Num 19.

translation: Kliaim mi wantaim aisop na bai mi klin; wasim mi na bai mi kamap wait moa long snek.
